meta.title: Session N4 risk register - business-as-usual and black-swan risks mapped to every decision
meta.note: Rows marked 'priced hazard' carry an official probability or documented loss range; rows marked 'qualitative' have a source link for the mechanism but no official probability, and no number is invented.

risks.name: Tenant same-store sales contraction
risks.description: Jack in the Box system SSS -1.1% in Q3 FY2026 after -7.1% in Q3 FY2025; transactions down, price-mix masking weakness.
risks.impact_if_realized: Lower percentage rent (if any), weaker renewal rent, higher closure risk at this unit.
risks.mitigation: Lease with corporate guaranty or strong franchisee operator; monitor quarterly SSS.

risks.name: Franchise system net closures
risks.description: 13 net closures (-0.6%) in Q3 FY2026; restaurant count 2,115 vs 2,168 a year earlier; 'JACK on Track' closure program.
risks.impact_if_realized: Risk that the subject unit itself is on a closure list at renewal.
risks.mitigation: Obtain operator identity and unit-level sales before extending term; keep sale option open.

risks.name: Interest-rate path higher-for-longer
risks.description: 10-year Treasury at 4.88% (2026-11-09) with fed funds upper limit 4.00%; prolonged high rates pressure cap rates and buyer demand.
risks.impact_if_realized: Exit cap expansion compresses sale price in 2030-2035.
risks.mitigation: Prefer term (extension) that lets you sell into a better window, or sell sooner with §1031.

risks.name: Cap-rate expansion at expiry
risks.description: Exit cap rate is unknown and unforecastable; every workbook's answer flips across the published breakeven band (6.52%-6.97%).
risks.impact_if_realized: A 100 bp expansion materially cuts proceeds on a 2030-2035 sale.
risks.mitigation: Trigger-based decision rule in decisions.json: appraised cap vs solved breakeven.

risks.name: Regional population decline
risks.description: Census Vintage 2025: city -0.8%, county -3.2% from Apr 2020 to Jul 2025; CA DOF path cited by LAEDC has county below 9.5M by 2034.
risks.impact_if_realized: Slower long-run demand growth for in-city QSR traffic and rents.
risks.mitigation: Do not underwrite aggressive rent growth; keep horizon moderate.

risks.name: Weak local job and income growth
risks.description: LAEDC forecasts slow real GCP growth (1.4%-1.5%); metro employment +0.5% YoY with information, manufacturing, finance and government all declining.
risks.impact_if_realized: Tenant traffic and franchisee margins stay under pressure.
risks.mitigation: Favor extension rents at or below in-place, not above, unless term is long.

risks.name: Wage inflation squeezing operator margins
risks.description: State min wage $16.90 (2026), City of LA $18.42 (Jul 2026), fast-food $20.00; metro ECI +3.9% YoY.
risks.impact_if_realized: Franchisee resist rent increases; renewal negotiations harder.
risks.mitigation: Model renewals at flat-to-modest rent; use escalators tied to CPI with a floor.

risks.name: Transfer-tax drag on any sale (in-city)
risks.description: If the parcel is in the City of LA, a taxable sale carries 0.45% base + 4.0%/5.5% ULA + 0.11% county = 4.56%-6.06% of price.
risks.impact_if_realized: First-order reduction of net sale proceeds vs an out-of-city parcel.
risks.mitigation: Confirm city status (Q05); factor ULA into every exit scenario; §1031 does not eliminate transfer taxes.

risks.name: ULA threshold creep
risks.description: Thresholds re-index annually by BLS chained CPI; current $5.4M/$10.9M for closings after 2026-06-30.
risks.impact_if_realized: Tier boundaries move each year; model must use the threshold in force at closing.
risks.mitigation: Re-check the Office of Finance FAQ at listing.

risks.name: Proposition 13 reassessment raises buyer's carry
risks.description: Sale resets base year value to market (BOE LTA 2025/023); buyer underwrites 1%+ of price in tax.
risks.impact_if_realized: Reduces what buyers can pay (their yield net of reset tax is lower).
risks.mitigation: Price the reset into expectations; do not compare gross cap rates across tax regimes.

risks.name: Extension not available or on punitive terms
risks.description: Tenant is contracting (R01/R02); may refuse, demand rent cut, or offer no guaranty.
risks.impact_if_realized: The extend-then-sell branch collapses toward sell-now, but with lost time.
risks.mitigation: Time-box the extension inquiry; keep the §1031 track warm in parallel (dual track).

risks.name: Holding into the final 3-4 years of term (financing cliff)
risks.description: Prior workbooks document that lenders curtail amortizing debt as WALT drops below ~6 years, widening required yields; buyers discount short-WALT assets.
risks.impact_if_realized: Sale proceeds deteriorate the closer you sell to expiry without term.
risks.mitigation: Never plan a passive hold into the last 3-4 years: sell or extend before the cliff.

risks.name: Vacancy at expiry with no renewal
risks.description: If the tenant vacates at expiry, the asset sells vacant or re-lets at cost.
risks.impact_if_realized: Vacancy carry, refit cost, and a materially lower price (prior workbooks model a 'sell vacant' branch that ranks worst).
risks.mitigation: Secure extension before expiry; start renewal talks 24-36 months out.

risks.name: Section 1031 execution failure
risks.description: Exchange requires identifying replacement within the statutory window and closing within the second window (Form 8824 mechanics).
risks.impact_if_realized: Forced to close taxable and pay tax, i.e. the sell-now branch becomes a cash-tax event.
risks.mitigation: Engage a qualified intermediary and line up replacement assets before listing (Q11).

risks.name: Tax-rate change before sale
risks.description: Federal and California rates applicable to the owner were not verified this session (N72 blank).
risks.impact_if_realized: Changes the after-tax gap between branches.
risks.mitigation: Confirm with tax adviser before decision (Q12).

risks.name: Insurance cost or non-renewal
risks.description: California property insurance availability and pricing have been the swing factor for LA assets after 2025 fires; subject quote unknown (N102 blank).
risks.impact_if_realized: Direct NOI hit; can exceed rent growth for years.
risks.mitigation: Get the quote first (Q08); treat insurance as a hold-period cost in every scenario.

risks.name: Concentration / wealth risk to the individual
risks.description: A single parcel in a single market with a single tenant; owner's concentration limit unknown (Q30).
risks.impact_if_realized: Idiosyncratic shock hits the whole personal balance sheet.
risks.mitigation: If this parcel is a large share of net worth, bias toward the §1031 diversification branch.

risks.name: Major earthquake (Los Angeles region)
risks.description: USGS/UCERF3: 60% probability of M6.7+, 46% of M7.0+, 31% of M7.5+ within 30 years in the Los Angeles region.
risks.impact_if_realized: Structural damage, casualty, business interruption, post-event demand shock; uninsured portion falls on owner.
risks.mitigation: Earthquake insurance decision (Q08); parcel seismic class (Q09); do not defer the sale decision into a post-event window.

risks.name: Wildfire reaching a central-LA parcel
risks.description: 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires: 14,021 and 23,448 acres, 9,414 and 6,837 structures destroyed, $5.2-10.1 billion output lost, ~6,800 businesses impacted.
risks.likelihood: low for a dense central parcel, non-zero (FHSZ unknown - N99)
risks.impact_if_realized: Total loss or long closure; regional demand shock; insurance dispute risk.
risks.mitigation: Confirm FHSZ (Q09); replacement-cost insurance; wildfire endorsement review.

risks.name: Recession / consumer-spending shock
risks.description: Prior LA recessions were severe (LAEDC: county employment -8.6% and real GCP -5.7% in 2020).
risks.impact_if_realized: Traffic and franchisee performance fall together; cap rates widen.
risks.mitigation: Favor strategies that are liquid and reversible; avoid leverage growth.

risks.name: Pandemic-scale demand shutdown
risks.description: 2020 precedent in the same source: county employment -8.6% in the pandemic year.
risks.impact_if_realized: Rent deferrals, closures, transaction market freeze for months.
risks.mitigation: Liquidity reserve; prefer NNN structure with corporate credit.

risks.name: Tenant credit event (brand-level)
risks.description: Interim CEO, net closures, SSS declines, large securitized debt stack - the brand is in restructuring mode (Q3 FY2026 release).
risks.impact_if_realized: Lease payment default or rejection; asset re-tenancy at cost.
risks.mitigation: Read the 10-Q/10-K (S14) for lease-rejection language; guaranty strength; diversify via sale if credit weakens.

risks.name: Change of law: ULA expansion or Prop 13 reform
risks.description: ULA already re-indexes thresholds annually; ballot or legislative change could raise rates or extend to more conveyances.
risks.impact_if_realized: Direct hit to net sale proceeds or to the tax basis of holding.
risks.mitigation: Monitor City/BOE publications; do not build a decision on a repeal that has not happened.

risks.name: Flood at the parcel
risks.description: FEMA flood zone for the parcel unknown (N101 blank).
risks.impact_if_realized: Damage plus mandatory-insurance requirements for lenders.
risks.mitigation: Flood map lookup by APN (Q09).

risks.name: Localised civil disruption / access loss
risks.description: Regional protests, utility shutoffs or major street works can close a QSR's drive-thru for weeks; no official series exists.
risks.impact_if_realized: Temporary sales loss; tenant may seek rent abatement.
risks.mitigation: Lease abatement clauses reviewed at extension.

risks.name: Model risk from missing owner facts
risks.description: All eight owner-private facts (Q01-Q04, Q30 and related) are blank in every published workbook; models substitute assumptions.
risks.impact_if_realized: Decision quality capped until facts arrive; wrong-branch risk.
risks.mitigation: Treat the questions register as the gating checklist; no irreversible move before Q01-Q04 are answered.
